guarantee: Task-body projection avoids canonical task-corpus enumeration: it opens its requested document, graph-named masters for sprint annotations, and the owning master and explicitly listed task files for ordinary dependency facts, never another master by enumeration. Always-on projection retains canonical folder-level enumeration and ordering. Both retain the current external direct-grant annotation contract; the task-addressed census and legacy unaddressed fallback are explicit additional I/O, not zero-directory I/O. Body/corpus byte parity and schema-bearing admission remain governing intent.
title: Bounded task-document read with unchanged meaning
